message.content:
I have solid verified data. Let me assess before ordering.

**What I found:**
- **FY2024 (ended 2024-09-01) 10-K, filed 2024-10-09** — all figures confirmed via SEC lookup:
  - Net sales: $254,453M (vs $242,290M FY23) → **+5.0%**
  - Operating income: $9,285M (vs $8,114M) → **+14.4%**
  - Net income: $7,367M (vs $6,292M) → **+17.1%**
  - Diluted EPS: $16.56 (vs $14.16) → **+16.9%**
  - Operating cash flow: $11,339M
- **Quote:** $904.13 last, bid/ask 904.11/904.15
- **News:** The "roundup" sites returned only generic one-line filler ("shares were little changed... analysts weighed demand"), and one search snippet was quarantined by the security screen as fabricated figures. I found no substantive, verifiable news item — so I'm basing the decision on the audited 10-K, not on those pages.

**Assessment:** Fundamentals are strong and improving — margin expansion drove operating income up 14.4% on only 5.0% sales growth, and EPS grew 16.9%. The offset is valuation: at $904.13 against $16.56 EPS, COST trades at roughly **54.6x trailing earnings**, a rich multiple that leaves little room for error. Given that tension, I'll take a partial starter position rather than a full-size one, keeping capital available.
